approval.scope: Encoded URLs between components, readable presentation for people; automatic adapter encoding without changing native page addresses, slugs or stored identities.
approval.length_reporting_reply: thanks, re 2,048-byte transmission limit sooner. We must report that clearly: agreed

Url.format: absolute ASCII HTTPS URI without userinfo or fragment

semantics.scope: All v2 fields whose named type is Url, including CMS and same-plugin network fields. Preserved v1 is unchanged.
semantics.sender: The native platform/adapter supplies its authoritative URL in ASCII URI form before constructing a typed payload: international domains use IDNA A-labels and international path/query characters use UTF-8 percent-encoding.
semantics.receiver: Validate the supplied representation and preserve accepted bytes exactly. Do not repair malformed authority, encode, decode, reserialize, case-fold or Unicode-normalize the payload URL.
semantics.existing_encoding: Do not double-encode existing percent escapes, decode reserved characters, reorder query parameters or use whole-URL percent-encoding.
semantics.display: Human-readable titles, labels and safe display of international characters remain supported; display does not replace the actual link target or authorize a different address.
semantics.identity: No native URL, slug, external/native/resource/topic identity, ownership receipt, mutation replay tree or URL ancestry is migrated by this amendment.
semantics.limits_and_security: The unchanged 2048-byte maximum applies to the transmitted ASCII string. Require nonempty authority, valid percent triplets and port 1..65535; reject controls, spaces, backslashes, userinfo, fragments and literal or once-percent-encoded dot path segments. Current origin/scope/collision/native-alias checks remain separate and mandatory.
semantics.length_reporting: An over-limit encoded URL fails without shortening or renaming. The local adapter/plugin reports the affected field and the 2,048-byte transmission limit after encoding, without exposing the supplied URL or sensitive query data. The protocol code remains invalid_field; no response field or wire error code is added.
semantics.freeze: The base Alpha.23 tag, release manifest and approved-packet bytes remain immutable. This amendment is a separate local working member; a subsequent immutable release identity is not assigned or frozen here.
